hub_category_screen.candidates: Gentle marine-fat cooking; avoid degraded fats; iron/vitamin C pairing; soaking/sprouting; oxalate reduction; whole grains.
hub_category_screen.decision: Legacy leads preserved. Absorption/food oxidation does not by itself establish either approved mitochondrial operation.

hub_category_screen.candidates: Vitamin E; CoQ/ubiquinol; manganese/selenium; NAC/SAM; sulforaphane; MitoQ.
hub_category_screen.decision: Deficiency/genetic/preclinical contexts assessed. No general optimisation protocol admitted; MitoQ DNA/damage or performance endpoints not substituted for local membrane/protein protection.

hub_category_screen.candidates: High-fat exposure; fish-oil mixture; caloric restriction; ketogenic feeding; timing.
hub_category_screen.decision: PM4 adverse high-fat exposure retained as an experimental protocol with Dietary input No; ketogenic/CR evidence is contextual or unresolved, not a general recommendation.
Screened despite empty hub category. No sufficiently verified mission-specific practical protocol identified in this bounded assessment; not a claim of biological absence.
No adequately verified source-generation/local membrane-protection intervention identified. General oxidative-stress markers do not qualify.
PM4 aerobic activity retained with experimental context. PM5 sleep/recovery and exposure leads preserved but not newly admitted from general mitochondrial or systemic endpoints.

stopping_rationale: Core source regulation/adaptive signalling and local protective operations have primary support. Candidate-specific second searches addressed formulation, exposure, transport, tissue specificity and nulls. Remaining relations are explicitly unresolved or contextual after retrieval; no evidence-of-absence claim, mandatory human end-to-end assay or fixed Finding count is used.
remaining_retrieval_limits: Some historical chapters/full methods and exhaustive independent replication were not recovered. Source-specific limitations are distinguished from these retrieval limits; no SEC/CC score is invented.
